modeling_principle: Filter hard constraints first, then rank viable homes using self-described preferences, evidence confidence, and uncertainty.
missing_value_policy: Unknown stays null. It never becomes zero, false, or a negative signal. Missing consequential facts reduce confidence and are shown to the student.

feature_groups.privacy: session-local by default; save only with explicit consent

features.name: monthly_housing_budget
features.description: Maximum comfortable all-in monthly cost, not only advertised rent.

features.name: move_in_and_move_out
features.description: Required occupancy window, including semester, internship, and study-abroad timing.

features.name: campus_destinations
features.description: Buildings or areas the student actually visits, with weekly frequency and arrival times.

features.name: mobility_and_access_needs
features.description: Student-stated needs such as step-free route, elevator, accessible bath, visual alarm, or nearby accessible parking; never infer disability.

features.name: room_and_privacy_needs
features.description: Private/shared bedroom, private/shared bath, studio, quiet study space, floor preference, and maximum household size.

features.name: roommate_preferences
features.description: Sleep, study, cleaning, guests, substances, pets, temperature, noise, food sharing, and communication expectations.

features.name: household_and_pet_needs
features.description: Occupants, partner or family, pet type, vehicle count, bicycle storage, and storage needs.

features.name: lease_and_financial_constraints
features.description: Guarantor availability, income/credit requirements, individual versus joint lease, financial-aid timing, deposit ceiling, and sublet need.

features.name: amenity_preferences
features.description: Furnished, laundry, kitchen, air conditioning, fitness, outdoor space, package handling, parking, and other student-selected needs.

features.name: rent_concessions
features.description: Store headline and effective rent separately; include conditions and expiration.

features.name: annualized_all_in_cost
features.description: Comparable total over the student's required occupancy period with a visible formula and uncertainty interval.

features.name: installment_schedule
features.description: Distinguish number of payments from days of occupancy.

features.name: natural_light_noise_and_temperature_control
features.description: Prefer measured or unit-specific facts; label resident reports as anecdotal.

features.name: accommodation_process
features.description: Show contact and process; never promise an accommodation.

features.name: travel_time_distribution
features.description: Use morning/evening and winter-aware ranges rather than straight-line distance.

features.name: route_frequency_and_service_span
features.source: AAATA GTFS and U-M Magic Bus

features.name: winter_mobility_context
features.description: Show snow-route and sidewalk responsibility; do not pretend future clearing is guaranteed.

features.name: floodplain_proximity
features.source: City of Ann Arbor floodplain map

features.name: building_access_and_security_features
features.description: Entry control, lighting, locks, fire systems, and package handling; avoid demographic proxies.

features.name: public_incident_context
features.description: If used, show raw official context and limitations. Never create a neighborhood 'safety score' or infer risk from race, income, or other protected traits.

features.name: internet_provider_speed_and_terms
features.description: Availability is not measured in-unit performance.

features.name: energy_and_water_benchmark
features.source: City of Ann Arbor open data where covered

features.name: response_time_evidence
features.description: Keep official claims and resident anecdotes separate.

features.name: resident_signal_topics
features.description: No unverified allegation becomes a fact; show sample size, date, source, and disagreement.

features.name: field_confidence_and_freshness
features.description: Calculated per field, not once for an entire property.

features.name: conflict_and_missingness
features.description: Retain conflicting values and expose consequential unknowns.

prohibited_features_and_uses: No inferred race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexuality, disability, nationality, or other protected trait.
No demographic composition or protected-trait proxy as a ranking input.
No neighborhood safety score derived from demographics, reputation, or sparse anecdotes.
No synthetic choice or recommendation labeled as real student behavior.
No precise schedule, disability, financial, or roommate data retained without consent and a clear purpose.
